paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: Jesus is over EVERYTHING, and Paul wants you to see it. He says the Son is "the image of the invisible God," and that "in Him all things were created" (Colossians 1:15-16). Thrones, rulers, authorities, the things you can see and the things you can't, all of it was made through Him and for Him. Nothing is bigger than Him, and nothing is outside His reach.

And this huge Son didn't stay far away. God was pleased "to reconcile to Himself all things" through Him, "by making peace through the blood of His cross" (Colossians 1:20). Paul tells the Colossians they were once "alienated from God" (Colossians 1:21), and I know that feeling of being stuck in the dark. But now He has reconciled them to "present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence" (Colossians 1:22). Nobody earned that, friend. The peace was made for you, and it cost Him His life.

So what do you do with it? Paul says to keep on, "established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel" (Colossians 1:23). That means letting the One who holds all things together hold YOU together, one steady day after another. Keep your eyes on Him, give Him first place, and keep your ovens ready.
